page.layout: One block of running text on one printed page. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Below the last line, signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: lentius se invenisse ait. Habet autē eorum mistura hoc pacto. Aloes, scammonij, gummi, colocynthidis, bdellij, singulorū femun-cia. Capiat ex his æger pro viribus scrupulos tres, aut quatuor: Nec comitialibus modò, sed etiam vertiginosis & articularis, si quid aliud, auxiliantur: Excipiantur autem succo brasicæ. Post apophlegmatismis, & gargarismis cerebrum à crasis & viscidis excrementis expurgari præcipit. Vomitiones quoq; præseruationis gratia, plurimū commendat, siue ante cibos, siue abipsis excitentur: propterea quòd ea discutiant & euacuent, quæ in stomacho crassa & viscida inhærent. Hæc sunt in genere pharmaca, quib. hactenus usi sunt medici præcla-riores ad primarii morbi comitialis profli-gationem. Veruntamen quoniam à variis excitari causis solet: Idcirco singulis suum peculiare remedium asignare licet. Itaque si à sanguine oboriatur, & tum nullus adsit spasmus, primùm sanguis ex interna stri cubiti vena mittendus est: dein exis, quæ sunt iuxta talum eiusdem lateris, tandem ex utroq; crure. Occipitio affigendæ cucurbitulæ: vel ea pars candente ferro inurenda, ut inde continuò effluat sanies.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The word "præcla-" at the line end is partly worn in the scan but reads as præclariores continued on the next line. The abbreviation "dō" is read from a faint macron. The running head and page number are printed at the top; the N and Quòd at the foot are signature and catchword.
